description: A collection route has many small exceptions such as blocked access points, special pickups, recurring skip instructions, and unusual container locations that crews keep forgetting. All routes and customer names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 42-year-old route supervisor managing a route with many nonstandard stops
user_profile.context: The core route is stable, but the small exceptions are frequent enough to cause repeated service problems when forgotten
user_profile.communication_style: Exception-focused and concise, wants route quirks documented in a reusable operational format

fact_sheet.fact: The official designation for this route is BR-07 (Blue Ridge 07).
The primary assigned driver for route BR-07 is Jenna Carter.
The standard departure time for route BR-07 from the Apex Waste Solutions yard is 05:00 AM.
The security gate code for Evergreen Gardens at 1500 Blossom Lane is #4815.
The rear gate at Pinnacle Manufacturing, 1 Industrial Way, is only open for service between 7:00 AM and 9:00 AM.
The service alley behind Starlight Cafe on 210 Main Street is consistently blocked by brewery delivery trucks on Tuesdays before 8:00 AM.
Oakwood Senior Living at 300 Tranquility Path requires key fob #A992 to open the service entrance gate.
The alley for The Gilded Spoon Restaurant is one-way eastbound; vehicle must enter from Elm Street.
The residential stop at 1120 Maple Avenue has a low-hanging communication cable over the driveway, requiring a spotter for clearance.
Starlight Cafe's cardboard recycling bin is located behind the adjacent bakery, 'Sweet Dreams Patisserie'.
The 30-yard scrap metal open-top container for Pinnacle Manufacturing is located on the north side of Building C.
The main trash dumpster for Westside Medical Clinic is secured behind a locked wooden fence; the key is attached to gate fob #A992.
The Gilded Spoon's general waste dumpster is shared with 'Elm Street Books' and is often moved to the opposite side of the alley.
The residential recycling cart for 1120 Maple Avenue is kept inside the garage; the homeowner leaves the garage door open on service days.
Westside Medical Clinic requires a special collection of two red 32-gallon biohazard bins every Friday.
Pinnacle Manufacturing's cardboard must be baled before pickup; this stop requires rear-loader truck #21B.
Evergreen Gardens receives green waste collection on the 1st and 3rd Monday of each month only.
The 50-gallon used cooking oil drum at Starlight Cafe must be visually checked for its fill level each week, even if not scheduled for emptying.
The Gilded Spoon's glass recycling bin is located just inside the kitchen's back door and requires the driver to enter the building to retrieve it.
Oakwood Senior Living has three separate dumpster locations on its property that must all be serviced each visit.
A scheduled bulk item pickup (one sofa) is noted for 945 Pine Street on June 15th, 2024.
Skip all service for 'Vacation Homes Inc' at 400 Lakeview Drive between November 1st and April 15th annually due to seasonal closure.
If the grease trap at Starlight Cafe is observed to be overflowing, do not service the dumpster and report immediately via the RouteOptix app with a photo.
The roll-off container at 818 Cedar Lane is on a 'call-in only' basis; do not service unless it appears on the daily manifest.
If the main gate at Pinnacle Manufacturing is still locked after 09:00 AM, skip the stop and log 'Late Access' code 5A in RouteOptix.
For gate issues at Evergreen Gardens, contact the property manager, Sarah Chen, at 555-0182.
The shipping manager at Pinnacle Manufacturing, Dave Holt, must be called at 555-0199 to confirm scrap metal pickups 24 hours in advance.
All service exceptions must be logged in the RouteOptix tablet software using the correct exception code before leaving the customer's location.
The direct cell number for route supervisor Marco Diaz for urgent escalations is 555-0100.
Urgent, non-emergency route issues and updates should be posted in the company's Slack channel #br-07-ops.
Route BR-07 is assigned truck #14C, a front-loading vehicle with a 40 cubic yard capacity.
On Fridays, the route requires a vehicle swap to rear-loader truck #21B to service the biohazard bins at Westside Medical Clinic.
The service alley behind The Gilded Spoon has poor lighting; vehicle-mounted floodlights must be used for any service before 6:30 AM.
Be aware of high pedestrian traffic from residents at Oakwood Senior Living, especially between 7:30 AM and 8:30 AM.
